brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Built a small hex shelf unit: four Hex base · Full blocks (3 on level 0 at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), plus one on level 1 at (0,0,1)), with three 2-compartment full-depth bins (at (1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1)) as the open storage cells. All open faces capped and joints bolted (capOpenFaces, lockJoints); check_build reports no issues and meshClash is clear. Books were not placed: the book props did not fit the compartments (PROP_NO_REST, cell wall), so the shelves are empty in the dressed view.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit and collisions only; it cannot verify a load rating. The parts are 3D-printed PETG clamped with M6 bolts, and the bom notes say to tighten them by hand to about 2 N.m. Nothing in this build establishes 50 kg capacity, so I have not claimed it. A load test on the printed parts would be needed.
Two notch drawers (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) at (-1,1,0) and (1,1,0), each filling the empty position between two touching bases; BOM lists 2 Notch drawer bodies, 2 frames, 2 lids and runners.

finish.summary: Built a compact hex shelf unit: four full bases, two notch drawers on the front-facing empty positions, and three 2-compartment bins as open shelf cells, with caps and locked joints. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. The 50 kg book rating cannot be verified by the configurator and is unmet; the shelves are unloaded because book props did not fit the bin compartments.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
